packages.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Story Director Laid Off Just a Week Before Early Access Launch

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Gears of War: E-Day's story director has been laid off, just one week before the game's early access launch.
Gears of War: E-Day Story Director Laid Off Just a Week Before Early Access Launch
Earlier today, Microsoft continued its ongoing reset of the Xbox brand, resulting in 268 staff members losing their jobs across a number of studios. Many of these employees seemed to be veteran or senior talent, one of the most prominent examples being Juan Vaca, a story director at Gears of War developer The Coalition. Vaca confirmed he was part of the latest round of Xbox layoffs after being with the company for four years.
The news comes at a pretty brutal time, as Vaca just publicly celebrated the game going gold last week, and the title will enter early access next week, five days before its global launch. It's unclear what Microsoft is planning to do with The Coalition after Gears of War: E-Day's launch, but cutting key talent doesn't inspire a lot of confidence.
This isn't the only oddly-timed layoff, either. Halo Studios' cinematic director Josh Daniels was also laid off , just one day after getting a promotion. Halo Studios' fate is a lot clearer, however. Activision is taking charge on the future of Halo, while Halo Studios is being gutted. A small team will remain on to support existing Halo games, but a new team is being built under Activision to develop the next mainline game in the franchise.
Gears of War's future hasn't been outlined much by Microsoft. When E-Day was announced years ago, it was suggested that the team would eventually return to the ongoing storyline that was left hanging at the end of Gears 5 . However, it's unclear if that's still in the cards with all of the changes happening at Xbox.

packages.headline: NBA Star Steven Adams Says GTA 6's Launch Will Lead to a 'League-Wide' Drop in Performance for Athletes and Coaches

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
NBA athlete Steven Adams has warned that fans should expect a "league-wide" drop in performance for athletes across all sports in November due to GTA 6's release.
NBA Star Steven Adams Says GTA 6's Launch Will Lead to a 'League-Wide' Drop in Performance for Athletes and Coaches
Speaking with media, the Houston Rockets center warned that athletes' performance will drop in November — not just for the NBA, but also the NFL. He noted that the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 will likely distract players and coaches, but he expects things to improve in December once they've spent enough time with the game.
Steven Adams has jokes at media day: "I will say: you guys should anticipate November. The performance of the league, league-wide. GTA is dropping." pic.twitter.com/OIBnRbDFeL
"You guys should anticipate November. The performance of the league... league-wide. GTA is dropping. Look at the NFL, look at all the leagues, and watch them plummet, mate. Just for the month of November, performance is gonna go down; it should come back up. Most of the boys will get it done; hopefully they finish the game. Coaching as well, by the way. The coaching and scouts are going to be horrendous. Just for November, but it should bounce back in December, hopefully. Should be good."
Given the fact that GTA 6 is expected to be one of the biggest entertainment releases in history with a massive level of anticipation behind it, it's not surprising to hear that even athletes are preparing to grind the hell out of the game. A running joke has made the rounds about NFL quarterback Kyler Murray's performance dropping whenever a new Call of Duty game releases, but now that joke appears to be expanding to the vast majority of pro athletes.
Whether it really does have any kind of effect on performance remains to be seen. These are professionals, of course, and they will still prioritize their careers... But some may not get the same level of rest as they normally would when GTA 6 launches this fall.
Adams' comments come at the same time as another NBA-adjacent GTA 6 story . Today, construction was completed on a "Welcome to Vice City" sign on the Miami Heat's arena in Florida. The sign reportedly cost Rockstar a whopping $975,000 and is expected to remain attached to the arena's roof either until the end of the year or the end of the Miami Heat's home season. It's still unclear if there are any larger marketing deals with GTA 6 and the NBA, such as the debut of a TV spot for the game.
"Look at all the leagues, and watch them plummet."

packages.headline: Wardogs Season 2 Release Date Announced, Will Add Weather Including Rain

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Wardogs Season 2 has a release date, and the new content update will add weather effects, including rain.
Wardogs Season 2 Release Date Announced, Will Add Weather Including Rain
Wardogs Season 2 will arrive on October 15, and although we don't know much about it yet, we do know that it will add weather to the game. The first teaser showcases heavy rainfall over a battlefield, suggesting players will have to deal with the elements going forward.
Whether this will add any changes to the gameplay, such as making it harder to drive or creating visibility issues, remains to be seen. If handled right, it could really shake up the Wardogs experience, especially if weather comes and goes dynamically rather than being enabled in specific matches.
WARDOGS Season 02 is coming. Stay tuned for more. pic.twitter.com/XTEa3mPGj9
Season 2 will also feature a progress wipe, resetting everyone's unlocks and ranks back to square one. The aim is to rebalance the scales at the start of each season of Wardogs, preventing players who grind the game endlessly from dominating forever. In theory, without a wipe, it could devalue the entire in-game economy as players will eventually unlock everything and lose the incentive to do anything beyond killing enemies. However, some fans are understandably annoyed that they will have to re-unlock everything just one month after the game's early access launch.
Wardogs has become one of the biggest games of the year, selling over two million copies in its first weekend. It's unclear where the game is at now sales-wise, but it is continuing to be one of the most played games on Steam . We'll have to wait and see what Season 2 brings, but it seems like developer Bulkhead has no plans to slow down on expanding the game with exciting content.
Wardogs is also coming to consoles , but it won't be for a while. The team is targeting a 2028 release for the console version of the game, and a big reason for that is so that the team won't have to crunch . In a recent interview, Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer noted that although there is pressure to make a console version, he doesn't want to overwork the team.

packages.headline: ‘We were almost dead’: NeoGeo boss reveals forced redesign behind AES+ delay

sources.label: VGC News
sources.evidenceText:
Plaion reveals how the AI-driven chip shortage nearly cancelled NeoGeo AES+ entirely…
‘We were almost dead’: NeoGeo boss reveals forced redesign behind AES+ delay
Plaion reveals how the AI-driven chip shortage nearly cancelled NeoGeo AES+ entirely
The director behind SNK and Plaion’s upcoming NeoGeo AES revival has revealed how the global chip shortage forced it to reengineer the console, leading to the recently confirmed year-long delay and nearly canceling the device entirely.
NeoGeo AES+ was announced earlier this year, featuring full compatibility with original 1990s NeoGeo cartridges and a suite of quality-of-life improvements. However, months after pre-orders opened, Plaion and SNK recently announced a ten-month delay to September 2027.
Speaking to VGC at Tokyo Game Show , Plaion hardware & software director Ben Jones explained the slip came after it failed to procure the memory chips required to manufacture NeoGeo AES+, forcing it to rethink how the console worked.
“After we announced AES+, we received an overwhelming response and really significant levels of preorders,” Jones said. “So I straight away went into the procurement phase, and advised our partners in the Far East what our requirements were, and it’s the first time I’ve ever been refused ordering chips, and I’ve worked with Plaion for nearly 20 years in this field. I was like, ‘What do you mean you can’t get these chips? Oh, AI.’”
“With that in mind, we tasked ourselves to try and see if there was some kind of a workaround with using what’s called Serial NOR flash, which is basically the same as parallel, but because the NeoGeo only uses parallel flash, you have to do a conversion that lets you use serial flash, which is in easier demand and you can basically get them.”
Plaion ultimately determined it needed to redesign the cartridge chips with added technology that converted a serial signal into a parallel one. This work, combined with extra testing, is what resulted in NeoGeo AES+’s ten-month delay, Jones said.

Sega wanted to cancel the entire Sonic series but the first movie saved it, says Sonic Team head Iizuka
Sonic Team head Takashi Iizuka says Sega was planning to end the Sonic series entirely at one point.
He then noted that the series has had numerous ups and downs over the years, to the extent that Sega once wanted to draw a line under it and stop making Sonic games altogether.
Iizuka said it was the first live-action Sonic the Hedgehog movie, which was released in 2020 and was a major critical and commercial success, which essentially ‘saved’ Sonic and changed Sega’s plans.
Elsewhere in the interview, Iizuka said that Sega had also planned to kill off the Shadow the Hedgehog character, but his popularity convinced it to change its mind – something that pleased Iizuka personally, because Shadow is his favourite character.
The live-action Sonic film “definitely changed the course of this franchise,” he says
In an interview with One More Game , Iizuka was asked about the history of the series, which turned 35 this year.
“It has been 35 years, which means it has been longer than actually my children, so I look upon this franchise like sort of like my own son,” Iizuka replied.

sources.label: 36氪游戏圈大事件
sources.evidenceText:
拆解《Warframe》长青逆增长的运营策略
这款动作射击游戏逆龄增长？腾讯收购后月均用户数创纪录，最高+50%，怎么做到的？
一款已经积累8500万+全球用户的游戏，如今仍在突破用户规模上限。但深挖这个长线运营的成功案例，了解其“背景故事”后会发现，《Warframe》（星际战甲）最值得研究的地方还不仅仅如此。
2025年，腾讯国际市场收入首次突破100亿美元，同比增长33%——在全年业绩演示中，腾讯首次点名Digital Extremes旗下《Warframe》，将其近年的在线表现与国际游戏业务增长联系起来。
在2026年第二季度的业绩演示上，《Warframe》再次被点名，其中提到其总流水和平均日活跃用户都创下了历史新高。
作为腾讯海外重要的长青标杆，《Warframe》至今依然保持着持续增长的用户规模与活跃的产品生态，甚至成为大盘业务增长的新变量。 这种“逆龄”表现的背后，似乎有着与大部分F2P游戏不一样的运营逻辑和成长路径。

packages.headline: “物理演算”メトロイドヴァニア『アイアンブランブル』体験版が「99％・圧倒的に好評」の大人気。グラップリングフックで巨大機構を舞う、『ラスティッド・モス』開発元による新作

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
PLAYISMが9月17日に配信開始した、『Iron Bramble / アイアンブランブル』の体験版が好評を博している。
“物理演算”メトロイドヴァニア『アイアンブランブル』体験版が「99％・圧倒的に好評」の大人気。グラップリングフックで巨大機構を舞う、『ラスティッド・モス』開発元による新作
PLAYISMが9月17日に配信開始した、『 Iron Bramble / アイアンブランブル 』の体験版が好評を博している。本作の対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）で、2027年に発売予定。体験版時点で日本語にも対応している。体験版の配信開始から本稿執筆時点のおよそ5日間で、Steamユーザーレビュー533件中99％が好評の「圧倒的に好評」ステータスを獲得しており、製品版への期待感が高まっている。
本作の舞台は何らかの理由で、人間がいなくなり、「物語」がなくなってしまった世界。「物語を喰らう者」と呼ばれる存在である主人公のライラックは、新たな物語や詩が作られることのない世界に退屈していた。ライラックは、「アイアンブランブル」と呼ばれる謎の建造物の中で、今でも人間が過去の記憶を語り暮らしているという噂を聞く。そこで彼女は、物語を求めてお供の「パック」とともにアイアンブランブルへと挑むことになる。
アイアンブランブルは、「鉄の茨」を意味するその名の通り、大量の棘で覆われた謎の建造物だ。これを避けるため、ライラックはグラップリングフックを使用したアクションを使いこなして中を探索してゆくことになる。グラップリングフックにはゴムのような伸縮性があり、走ったり、落下の途中でどこかに引っかけたりすることで勢いをつけることで、フックが元に戻ろうとする反動を利用できる。これにより、より高くジャンプしたり、スピードをつけたりといったアクションに発展させることができるのだ。グラップリングフックは敵に引っかけることで戦闘にも活用できる。
『Iron Bramble / アイアンブランブル』はPC（ Steam ）で2027年発売予定。日本語表示にも対応予定。体験版は9月17日から配信中だ。
本作はサイバーゴシックの世界観で繰り広げられる、「モメンタムメトロイドヴァニア」を標榜するアクションゲームだ。本作の開発元のひとつであるEmliseは、高評価メトロイドヴァニア『Rusted Moss』を開発したスタジオ。本作でも、『Rusted Moss』の特徴であった伸縮性のあるグラップリングフックを使用した、勢い（モメンタム）を利用してのアクロバティックなアクションは健在。操作には慣れが必要なものの、様々な行動を使い分けることで自由度の高いアクションが可能だ。

subject.key: 50歳超えだけど今からゲーム開発者になれる

packages.headline: 「50歳超えだけど今からゲーム開発者になれる？」との人生相談に、“経験者”が大集結。年配組の熱い回答、あの人気ゲームのディレクターも名乗り出る

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
年齢を重ねてからでもゲーム開発者になれるのか。そんな人生相談のようなあるユーザーの書き込みが、海外掲示板Redditで注目を集めている。
「50歳超えだけど今からゲーム開発者になれる？」との人生相談に、“経験者”が大集結。年配組の熱い回答、あの人気ゲームのディレクターも名乗り出る
今回注目を集めているのはRedditユーザーExcitingSleep氏の「Any 45-50+ year olds who became game developers and found modest success?（45歳から50歳以上の年齢でゲーム開発者になってそれなりに成功した人っている？）」という 書き込み である。同氏は最近になってハイテク業界での仕事をやめることになり、50歳以上という自身の年齢を踏まえると業界への復帰は難しいと考えたという。そこで、早めに終業する仕事をしながら、余暇の時間でゲーム開発をしてみようと思い立ったようだ。そして、もしも同じような経験をした人がいれば実体験やアドバイスを聞きたいという問いに対し、多くの反応が寄せられた。中には有名ゲームのディレクターを務める人物までもが現れている。
もっとも注目された返信のひとつは「自分のことだ」として経歴を 語る ユーザー-Xaron-氏のものだ。ソフトウェアエンジニアだったという同氏がゲーム開発を始めたのは38歳の時で、10本のスマートフォン向けゲームをリリースしたものの失敗。その後46歳になってからフルタイムでゲーム業界で働き始め、50歳になってようやくゲーム開発で生計を立てられるようになったという。

packages.headline: 『Wizardry Variants Daphne』のTGSブースで、3面の巨大LEDで表現されたダンジョンを探索。最後の薬草を渡す、渡さないやトラップ濃厚の宝箱を自分で開けるかなどの判断が問われる

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
本稿では、『Wizardry Variants Daphne』のブースで体験できたコンテンツをお伝えしたい。
『Wizardry Variants Daphne』のTGSブースで、3面の巨大LEDで表現されたダンジョンを探索。最後の薬草を渡す、渡さないやトラップ濃厚の宝箱を自分で開けるかなどの判断が問われる
ドリコムの手がける『Wizardry Variants Daphne』は、基本プレイ無料の3DダンジョンRPGだ。プレイヤーはキャラクターの育成やダンジョンでのアイテム収集などを繰り返して、「奈落」と呼ばれるダンジョンの奥へと進んでいく。2024年10月にサービスが開始された本作は、2026年8月の時点で400万ダウンロードを達成した。
そんな『Wizardry Variants Daphne』が、東京ゲームショウ2026（以下、TGS2026）に出展された。本稿では、『Wizardry Variants Daphne』のブースで体験できたコンテンツをお伝えしたい。
『Wizardry Variants Daphne』はTGS2025で初めて出展されたが、昨年はコスプレイヤーのフォトセッションや撮影可能な企画展示がメインコンテンツだった。『Wizardry Variants Daphne』自体が2024年にリリースされているので、試遊コンテンツというよりはファン向けのコンテンツを充実させる狙いがあったものと思われる。
今年のTGS2026では、本作を知らない人でもその世界観に触れられる体験型のコンテンツが出展された。それは、LED3面で『Wizardry Variants Daphne』に登場するダンジョン「はじまりの奈落」を冒険できるコンテンツだ。サソリ女の討伐依頼を受けた冒険者として、プレイヤーは仲間と一緒にダンジョンへと向かう。LEDは高さ2.5mの大きなもので、3枚のLEDの前に立つとその迫力に圧倒されてしまう。本作は一人称視点で進行するため、プレイヤーキャラクターが一歩進む度に自分もダンジョンの奥へと足を伸ばしていくような気持ちになった。
道中でいくつかの選択に迫られたものの、仲間たちのがんばりによってなんとかサソリ女の討伐に成功したといった感覚だ。プレイヤーの選んだ内容によって展開が変化し、クエスト成功の可否が変わってくるらしい。今回の試遊ではギルドから依頼達成の認定も得られて、報酬として「ライオンハートシールド」を獲得することができた。プレイ時間は約5分と短い体験だったかもしれないが、LED3面を使用したダンジョン探索は感慨深い。普段プレイしているスマートフォンよりもはるかに大きな画面で、『Wizardry Variants Daphne』の世界観に浸れるコンテンツとして迫力満点だった。
『Wizardry Variants Daphne』のブースでは、ダンジョン内における拠点となる「ハーケン」を再現したフォトスポットも出展されていた。こちらのフォトスポットには、冒険者たちに扮したコスプレイヤーも登場し、来場者との記念撮影に応じてくれる。筆者がブースにうかがった際にはシェリリーニャとフルートがハーケンにいた。ダンジョン内の拠点というだけあって、そこはかとなく緊張感が伝わってくるようなフォトスポットだった。

subject.key: スター ウォーズ ギャラクティック レーサー

packages.headline: 『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』はフォースなし、ジェダイなしの濃厚「スター・ウォーズ」体験。なぜレース？マルチプレイの調整は？実際に遊んで開発者に訊いた

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
10月7日発売予定の『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』を試遊し、開発者に直接インタビューする機会に恵まれたのでその内容をお届けする。
『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』はフォースなし、ジェダイなしの濃厚「スター・ウォーズ」体験。なぜレース？マルチプレイの調整は？実際に遊んで開発者に訊いた
『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』はFuse Gamesが手掛け、Secret Modeが発売するスペースオペラ「スター・ウォーズ」シリーズの世界を舞台とするレースゲーム。10月7日に発売予定だ。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam/Epic Gamesストア）/PS5/XBOX Series X|Sで、日本語表示に対応する。
「スター・ウォーズ」といえばフォースという人も少なくないだろう。しかし『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』にはフォースも予言も登場しない。アウトローたちの過激なレースが描かれる。なのに確実に「スター・ウォーズ」のゲームである不思議な魅力をまとった作品であった。
弊誌からは「スター・ウォーズ」の知識もレースゲーム経験も人並み……といった筆者と、本作開発陣が携わった『バーンアウト』『ニード・フォー・スピード』シリーズのファンである2名で参加。フォースと銀河を股にかける戦いにフォーカスされがちな「スター・ウォーズ」の世界観のなかで、あえてレースシーンに目を向けた本作に触れた感想と、開発者の生の声をお届けする。なお本稿における本作の説明は、それぞれ試遊版における仕様となるため留意してほしい。
本作の舞台となるのは、帝国の支配が終わり、スピードへの熱狂が新たな娯楽として広がった銀河系。シングルプレイ向けのキャンペーンでは、大衆のエンターテイメントとして隆盛したレース「ギャラクティック・リーグ」をめぐるオリジナルストーリーが展開される。現在リーグは、悪党ケスター・ブールに牛耳られており、創設者であるダライアス・パックスは支配権を失う危機に立たされている。そこでダライアスは、ブール家に個人的な恨みを抱く一匹狼のレーサーであり、謎多き傭兵でもある「シェード」に協力を依頼。プレイヤーはシェードとしてレースに身を投じることになる。
筆者がまず驚いたのは、冒頭シーケンスの没入感を高める演出だ。プロローグはいきなりレースのカットシーンから始まる。機体の魅力とレースの空気感を伝える映像の途中でなめらかに操作が可能となり、そのまま一通りの操作を学ぶチュートリアルが開始。本作に登場する基本的な機種が切り替わる流れとなっており、ひとつの機種をある程度操作するとふたたびカットシーンから操作練習へと戻る。ランドスピーダー、スピーダーバイク、スキムスピーダーの3種のマシンの操作感を順番に味わうことができるようになっていた。前述のようなストーリーへの導入が、カットシーンと操作シーンがシームレスに切り替わる没入感の高い体験で提供されるかたちだ。 こうして「ギャラクティック・リーグというレースが盛り上がっているんだな」と理解したところで、主人公シェードのカスタマイズへ。好みに合わせて服装、ヘルメット、音声を選ぶことができる。難易度を選択した後、ふたたびストーリーが進んでいく。
プロローグに戻ると、シェードを招集したダライアスより突然エキシビションレースに放り込まれ、本作最大の宿敵・ケスターといきなり直接対決することに。レース中の無線や試合後にはケスターにかなり罵られることになり、筆者も「こいつ嫌なやつだな」と、ケスターに恨みを抱くシェードと心がシンクロ。やがてレースが終わり、ダライアスより改めてリーグに参加しろと誘われるという流れだ。
このたび弊誌は、東京ゲームショウ2026にあわせて本作を試遊プレイする機会に恵まれた。また、試遊の際には開発元Fuse GamesのCEO兼共同創設者であるMatt Webster氏およびクリエイティブディレクターであるKieran Crimmins氏が同席、説明を受けながらの試遊後にはインタビューも実施した。

『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』TGSバトルプレイ感想。最終作のバトルは、自由で、難しくて、面白い。黒魔道士ティファ躍動、ヴィンセントはちょっと難しい
スクウェア・エニックスは、『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』を東京ゲームショウ2026（TGS2026）に試遊出展した。発売日が2027年4月8日に決定した本作は情報公開が加速しているところで、TGS2026では世界初となる一般ユーザー向けの試遊が実施された。
今回の試遊では、クラウドたちがセフィロスを追いかけて「竜巻の迷宮」と呼ばれる場所を訪れるところだった。原作では竜巻の迷宮をクリアしたあとにメテオの脅威に世界がさらされることになるので、『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』のストーリーにおいて重要なシーンのひとつといえるだろう。タイミング的にはシドが新規バトルメンバーになってパーティーを明るく盛り上げてくれるものの、竜巻の迷宮は落雷がしばしば発生するなど不穏な場所だ。
ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション 』は、PC（ Steam / Epic Gamesストア / XBOX on PC ）/ Nintendo Switch 2 / PS5 /XBOX Series X|S 向けに2027年4月8日に発売予定。「ファイナルファンタジーVII リメイクシリーズ」 三部作セットになったトリロジーエディションは購入後すぐに1作目と2作目をプレイ可能 だ。三部作セットは『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』発売前ならば、1万1330円（税込）のお買い得価格で購入できる。なお、 弊誌ではオープンワールドの探索を中心とした8月に実施された試遊会の感想記事も掲載中 なので、そちらもぜひ読んでほしい。。
『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』の容量、「約200GB」になりそう。『FFVII リメイク』2本分
弊誌は、TGS2026で試遊可能なビルドを体験できるメディア向けセッションに参加することができた。TGS2026で試遊できるビルドはバトル体験を重視したものでありながらも、クラウドとセフィロスの因縁に関する重要なストーリーも垣間見えることができた。約30分の試遊を通じて得られたプレイフィールを、本稿でお伝えしたい。

TGS2026では、御影リズ役の柊優花氏を招いたメディア向け合同インタビューが開催された。弊誌も参加することができたので、その模様を本稿でお伝えしたい。

Blizzard Reveals the World of Warcraft Forever Feature 'We Simply Must Hold the Line On'
Keeping the spirit of Classic.
Ever since Blizzard revealed World of Warcraft: Forever at Blizzcon 2026 , the company has been laser-focused on maintaining its Classic+ identity, even if that means not implementing some quality-of-life features the game's retail version has had for years.
In a reply to GingiTV and Nobbel87 , two of the biggest WoW personalities on X/Twitter (albeit from complete opposite ends of the community), Blizzard developer Josh Greenfield confirmed that not implementing shared drops and tagging was "one of those things that we simply must hold the line on." He continued, saying "It’s hard to see the value in something like this when you are frustrated in the moment but it is extremely important to our social pillar to maintain some of this friction."
Yep, this. This is one of those things that we simply must hold the line on. I think there are other things we can do to help alleviate some frustration here but shared tagging is not it. It’s hard to see the value in something like this when you are frustrated in the moment but…
In the retail version of World of Warcraft, players who are questing or trying to farm rare spawns can all tag the same enemy (to a limit), so that everyone can get the rewards for killing it. This makes it a lot easier to play the game outside of a group, but it all but eliminates the need to group up with other players outside of high-end group content like dungeons and raids.
It's not hard to see why some people would want shared tagging implemented in Forever, too. The beta for this new version of old World of Warcraft has been incredibly popular , which means there's a lot of competition for anyone that just wants to kill some boars for some bones. The solution, which was suggested by Nobbel and confirmed by Greenfield is to "group up and get it done together," which will give people more opportunity to socialize, which is really what WoW Forever is designed for.

packages.headline: Garfield - Escape from Monday Review

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
A lackluster 3D platformer that leaves you feline hungry for something better.
Garfield - Escape from Monday Review
If there are two things to know about Garfield, it’s that he loves lasagne and he hates Mondays. So, it should come as no surprise that developer OSome Studio’s rendition of Jim Davis’s beloved cartoon series, Garfield - Escape from Monday, is heavily bound to those two themes. Set across a series of foodie nightmare worlds, this 3D platformer sees the famous tabby kicking veggies and chomping processed snacks to awaken from a fibre-fuelled fugue state. Sadly, like other disappointing cartoon adaptations (such as SpongeBob SquarePants: The Patrick Star Game ), this exploration of the food-obsessed feline’s psyche is actually rather dull. Its overly familiar platforming and excessively camera-winking writing make it little more than a dazzling but sarcasm-laden slog.
Escape from Monday kicks off with a toon-shaded Garfield haphazardly shoveling a slice of what he thinks is Jon’s lasagne into his gullet. Once he realizes the meal is actually laden with veggies, he quickly passes out and is transported to an inner world called the Dreamland, which conveniently takes the form of a board-game course reminiscent of Super Mario Galaxy 2. Here, a vegetarian TV chef, knowingly named Monday, has transformed his cheese-and-meat fantasies into approachable, obstacle-filled levels, stocking them with aggressive snacks to boot. With a kick, a jump, and a forward boost in your arsenal, plus a forgiving health bar, you run Garfield through these stages to eventually wake him up.
The story rarely dives deeper than this initial premise, and leaves you with little more to chew on than "bad food is yummy" and "veggies are gross." I’m not looking for Shakespeare, but it does feel like a wasted opportunity considering how much personality Garfield has in other incarnations (heck, even Bill Murray’s 2004 interpretation had a heart), and how much room there is to have fun with that here. Alas, instead of a sarcastic hero you can root for, Escape from Monday orbits something much worse: an unlikeable cat who delivers a stream of constant complaints until you hit the credits 40-plus levels later.
This one-dimensional attitude grows increasingly grating throughout the roughly 9-hour runtime. Garfield is relentlessly grumbling. When he’s not lamenting his situation, he’s waxing lyrical about the developers, pointing out how certain obstacles or puzzles are repetitive and uninteresting. When his friends appear like expository force ghosts, he continues to disparage them, too. Parading as a PG-13 Deadpool, the meta-humour gradually begins to feel like an excuse, his hypercritical lens intending to lower my own expectations rather than make me laugh.
As you work your way through the zany levels, you’ll also collect hunks of lasagna that fuel a metagame where you furnish a surreal version of Jon Arbuckle’s apartment. To unlock physical versions of sofas and lampshades, you need to find slices hidden in each level, whilst simultaneously gathering enough snacks to fill an on-screen pressure gauge called the Yum-o-meter. While this technically provides extra goals beyond simply reaching the end, the system ultimately feels like an afterthought, so disconnected from the main game it’s easy to forget about his fantasy apartment altogether – I know I did.
Thankfully, the art style provides a much-needed distraction. Escape from Monday’s aesthetics are delightful, evoking the blocky simplicity of PS1 platformers like Rugrats: Royal Ransom. sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Rockstar Games has reportedly spent $1 million to install a "Welcome to Vice City" sign in Miami as part of Grand Theft Auto 6's marketing push.
Grand Theft Auto 6's Miami Takeover Begins as Rockstar Spends Nearly $1 Million on 'Welcome to Vice City' Signage
Rockstar Games has reportedly spent nearly $1 million to install a "Welcome to Vice City" sign in Miami as part of Grand Theft Auto 6's marketing push.
Fans have been monitoring the construction of the sign for the last few days, and it's finally complete. The sign was lifted to the top of the Kaseya Center by a helicopter this afternoon and firmly installed on the roof. Now, those who fly over the arena will be able to look out their window and see a greeting from Rockstar itself. You can see the sign below.
Welcome to Vice City y'all 😎 #miami #gta #vicecity #gtavı https://t.co/IxrIZRegwX pic.twitter.com/iGUvA7ScUX
According to Miami Herald journalist Doug Hanks , Rockstar Games paid just shy of $1 million to install this sign. Miami-Dade is expected to collect $975,000 for the sign from Rockstar as part of a marketing agreement. As of right now, it's unclear how else Rockstar plans to market GTA 6 in Miami, but there were extensive conversations with the city in August that involved pitches for various events, a takeover of the airport, and more. Whether any of those will actually happen are up in the air at the moment.
The city also had a somewhat contentious battle over whether or not it should play a role in marketing Grand Theft Auto 6 , since the game revolves around crime and allows the player to gun down police and civilians. However, the city ultimately ruled in favor of the campaign in the end .
The Kaseya Center is also where the Miami Heat plays, so it's possible Rockstar might also leverage the NBA to market GTA 6. Miami Heat's first regular season home game will be on October 21, and it wouldn't be surprising if the broadcast features a shot of the signange. Whether Rockstar will debut any kind of trailer or other marketing around the broadcast remains to be seen, but it would come at an ideal time. By that point, GTA 6 will be just under a month away from launch, and TV spots will likely begin advertising the release to get more mainstream audiences aware.
Documents reviewed by IGN reveal that the sign will remain on top of the arena either for "the latter of one year after" installation or until the last home game of Miami Heat's 26-27 season, which is scheduled for April 11, 2027. This suggets that the signage will be visible through the rest of 2026, with it also possibly lasting until the spring. The documents also reveal that the sign had an installation deadline of October 15 or else Rockstar could terminate the agreement. It's possible that October 15 will be another marketing beat for GTA 6, as it falls on a Thursday, which is a day that Rockstar has historically used for news about the game.

Call of Duty developer Activision is now taking over creation of the next Halo game, and fans are understandably divided about it.
Halo Fans Can't Decide if Activision Takeover Is a Good Thing or Not
Xbox’s latest shakeup saw a few big developments, most notably the mass layoffs at Halo Studios and the handover of Halo's next title to Activision .
This came as a wildly unexpected move from the company, and one that has sparked no end of debate across social media as fans discuss the future of the Halo franchise and what its next game could look like. Many comments are humorously envisioning a Halo game with absurd amounts of monetization, with wild celebrity skin crossovers a la Nicki Minaj .
“I remember in 2009, the Halo and COD communities were vastly different. We treated each other like different military powers in a war. I remember playing Halo: Reach and bouncing over to Black Ops II and it was a night and day difference in every aspect. I'd never believe that Halo would ever be made by a COD publisher,” one nostalgic player mused on Reddit .
“Bro, Halo Studios lasted less time than it took for them to add Slayer to Halo Infinite,” another joked , referencing how the developer had rebranded itself from Halo Studios to 343 Studios, only to get gutted by Xbox merely two years later.
“Welp, Halo is ruined. About to get hijacked from a Banshee by Nicki Minaj, who also has an Energy Sword that’s purple because someone got a $20 sword skin,” another said .

Dancing with Ghosts launches in Early Access on October 8
Dancing with Ghosts , the life simulation game about finding joy from grief by game developer Greg Johnson, will launch in Early Access for PC via Steam on October 8 for $14.99, developer HumaNature Studios announced. It will support English and Thai language options. A demo is available now.
“ Dancing with Ghosts is a deliberately joyful experience,” said Dancing with Ghosts creator and HumaNature Studios founder Greg Johnson in a press release. “We all experience sadness because that’s a natural part of being human—I had to find my way back to joy, and I want this game to help others on their path, while celebrating the Thai culture that guided me there.”
Dancing with Ghosts is a passion project for Johnson, whose work includes lead design on the ToeJam and Earl franchise, the Starflight series, and Doki-Doki Universe . The game was born in the wake of the tragic passing of Greg’s 28-year-old daughter and his family’s devastating loss in the 2023 Maui wildfires.
Greg found solace in the Thai culture and traditions his wife Sirena brought into his life, offering ways to rise and grow from grief. This philosophy, combined with his mind for game design, created a cozy experience celebrating joy and Thai culture, enlisting talent from both Thailand and the diaspora for art, programming, animation, and voice acting.
In Dancing with Ghosts , after a tragic accident claims the lives of her parents, 15-year-old Mai must rebuild her life in the Thai river village where she grew up. As Mai processes the loss of her family and struggles with grief, she meets a friendly young ghost named Pim struggling to remember almost any of her time in the world of the living—but is overjoyed to discover Mai can see and talk to her.
Help Mai and Pim make something positive out of their unfortunate situations by helping others, inspired by the Thai concept of utit suan boon kusohn, dedicating good karma to ease the way for those who have passed. Play mini-games like making deliveries by boat and scooter and cooking up delicious Thai food to help villagers with their daily tasks and earn Karma for Pim.

packages.headline: 'Do not': Rockstar outlines modding rules before GTA VI touches down

sources.label: Game Developer
sources.evidenceText:
Official Rockstar storylines, characters, and other elements from the studio's 'established continuity' are off-limits.
'Do not': Rockstar outlines modding rules before GTA VI touches down
Rockstar has restated its modding guidelines with the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI looming large, and the words "do not" appear in abundance.
Although the studio has yet to confirm a launch date for GTA VI on PC, it is being proactive about laying down the law for those who might want to tinker with the title when the time comes. The guidelines will also apply to existing releases such as GTA V and Red Dead Redemption II, both of which have well-established modding and roleplaying communities.
The rulebook was shared by Rockstar on September 10, 2026, and prohibits modders from creating content that combines maps, locations, characters, storylines, in-game assets, or other IP from one Rockstar title into another.
Notably, they also seek to prevent people from expanding or modifying official Rockstar storylines, plots, missions, characters, or other elements from the studio's "established continuity."
Multiplayer modding has been restricted to Rockstar's official licensed Creator Platform—unless the studio has stated otherwise. Any creations that infringe on Rockstar Games' own or third-party IP and services are off-limits, too.
"Do not use protected elements of anyone else's intellectual property in your mod, including art, characters, music, photos, games, advertisements, brands or logos, real-world locations, etc," read the guidelines. "Do not modify or reuse voiceover performances from any game released by Rockstar Games. Do not use any real-world person's voice, image, or likeness without written permission."
